changelog_added: Stat on a version's disclosure line: how many new things the technical list holds. {n} is a number.
changelog_all_changes: Title of the disclosure under each version that opens the full technical list.
changelog_alpha_report: Link text after the alpha notice; opens a new GitHub issue.
changelog_also: Heading of the short list of smaller changes under a release story.
changelog_art_note: Small note under the illustrations of a release story.
changelog_badge_alpha: Badge on a version cut as an alpha.
changelog_badge_beta: Badge on a version cut as a beta.
changelog_badge_pre: Badge on a version cut with a prerelease label Atlas does not use for a channel.
changelog_changed: Stat on a version's disclosure line: how many existing things changed. {n} is a number.
changelog_count_many: Status line read by screen readers after the filter changes, for 2 or more versions.
changelog_count_one: Status line read by screen readers after the filter changes, for exactly one version.
changelog_date_locale: BCP 47 tag the release dates are written in. Not shown to people.
changelog_filter_legend: Label of the version filter group.
changelog_filter_pre: Filter option: show only prerelease versions.
changelog_filter_stable: Filter option: hide prereleases whose own stable version is listed.
changelog_fixed: Stat on a version's disclosure line: how many fixes the technical list holds. {n} is a number.
changelog_intro: Subtitle under the changelog page title.
changelog_latest: Small label above the newest version at the top of the page.
changelog_meta_description: Meta description of the changelog page.
changelog_meta_title: Title of the changelog page (browser tab and search results).
changelog_release_link: Link on each version to its GitHub release page.
changelog_stale: Notice shown when the page serves its last good copy. {tag} is the release tag it was read from.
changelog_technical_note: One line under the disclosure title: says the list below is the technical one. In Portuguese it says the list stays in English.
changelog_title: Main heading (h1) of the changelog page.
changelog_versions_label: Accessible name of the list of version links that jump to each version.
